verdict.rationale: ByteAsk claims live JetBrains connectors for CLion, IDEA and PyCharm, and the llms.txt index lists editor connectors. Its diff review is documented only in the terminal TUI, not inside the IDE. missing for 10: evidence of interactive diff viewing inside JetBrains, evidence of sharing selected code as context from the IDE, connector documentation beyond a one-line mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.
